input.edges: Borrowed span<Edge>{uint32 from,to,int64 weight}; copied at construction
input.structure: Directed arcs; loops and parallel arcs accepted; encode undirected edges as two arcs

output.neighbors: Paired const spans for targets and weights in insertion order within a vertex

constraints.errors: Negative weights rejected; invalid endpoints/vertices throw; allocation may throw
constraints.lifetime: Neighbor views depend on graph storage; no mutation while used; moved-from instance only destroy/reassign
constraints.threading: Concurrent const access on the same live immutable graph

complexity.space: sizeof(size_t)*(n+1) + 12m payload bytes; build cursor adds sizeof(size_t)*(n+1)

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative lower bound on owned payload, not a peak-allocation upper bound; excludes container headers, allocator overhead and caller input

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants in documentation; not formally verified
evidence.notes: Negative weights, endpoints, loops, parallel arcs and empty graph exercised through graph tests

provenance.implementation: Written for this project; no source code copied
